scripts.test: bun db && bash -c 'for i in {1..30}; do pg_isready -h localhost -p 5433 -U dzql && break || sleep 1; done' && sleep 20 && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://dzql:dzql@localhost:5433/dzql bun test tests/
scripts.db:up: cd database && docker compose -p rights up -d
scripts.db:down: cd database && docker compose -p rights down -v
scripts.db:logs: cd database && docker compose -p rights logs postgres
scripts.db:admin: echo 'Adminer available at: http://localhost:8081' && echo 'Server: postgres:5433 | User: dzql | Pass: dzql | DB: dzql'
